---
title: 'Do "Community Preference" Policies Violate the Fair Housing Act? (Part 1)'
date: '2022-02-06'
author: Nick Arnosti
---

New York City faces a lawsuit alleging that its "Community Preference" policy creates a disparate racial impact. In this video, I explain why the analysis conducted by the plaintiffs' "expert witness" does not address this claim.

The slides accompanying this lecture are [available here](/Beveridge_Commentary.pdf).
